title: PromptScript Prompt Release Pricing v1

$schema.description: Schema URL, the version tag of the file.

models.description: Priced models sorted by ref. Models without a known price are left out.

description: List prices of the models that the bundles of a release use, version 1. Outside every content hash: a price update never changes a bundle. The prices are estimates, cache, batch and tier discounts are ignored.

ref.description: Catalog profile id of the model.

apiId.description: Provider API model identifier, as the bundles carry it.

inputUsdPerMillion.description: Price of one million input tokens in USD.

outputUsdPerMillion.description: Price of one million output tokens in USD.

checkedOn.description: Date the price was checked against the provider, YYYY-MM-DD.

PromptReleasePricingModel.description: One priced model of a release, as `prs release build` writes it.
